title: Settings
documentsIntro: These documents govern your use of the application. They open on our website.
dataText: To get a copy of your data or to have your account deleted, write to us. We handle such requests within one month.
dataNote: What exactly happens to the records is described in the Privacy Policy above.
parentNoticeHint: The notice for parents is not about you — it is a ready-made text to hand over, so you do not have to write your own.
subscribeText: Choose your plan whenever you are ready — you can subscribe during the trial too.
billingText: Change your card, switch plan or cancel — all in one place.

billingErrors.unavailable: Could not open it right now. Please try again later.
billingErrors.noSubscription: You do not have a paid subscription yet.

billingDetails.heading: Billing details
billingDetails.intro: Buying as a company? Whatever you fill in here appears on your invoices. Fill it in before you subscribe — an invoice that has already been issued cannot be changed.
billingDetails.vatHint: Your VAT number does not go here. Enter it at checkout under “I'm purchasing as a business” — and only if your company is VAT registered, because it changes how VAT is charged.
billingDetails.saved: Saved. Your next invoice will include these details.

errors.tooLong: Each field can have at most 140 characters.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save your details. Please try again.
errors.notSynced: Your details are saved, but we could not update your invoices right now. Please save them again later.
